headline: Committee confirms 2026 Nashua Multicultural Festival date and venue, reviews festival planning for stage, vendors, volunteers, and marketing.
summary: The Cultural Connections Committee confirmed the 2026 Nashua Multicultural Festival will be held on Saturday, September 26, 2026 at Renaissance Park. Members discussed stage setup, performer changing areas, parking, sponsors, food vendors, water and restroom logistics, weather planning, a new children's flag scavenger hunt activity, volunteer recruitment, t-shirts, and marketing efforts. Approval of the previous meeting's minutes was postponed due to lack of quorum.
decisions: Postponed approval of the previous meeting's minutes due to lack of quorum.
Confirmed the 2026 Nashua Multicultural Festival will take place on September 26, 2026 at Renaissance Park.

decision_evidence.quote: There was not sufficient quorum to approve the previous meeting minutes. Approval of the prior minutes was therefore postponed until the next meeting.
The Committee confirmed that the 2026 Nashua Multicultural Festival will take place on: Saturday, September 26, 2026 Renaissance Park
